title: ArcCivs actual construction, city inventory and deletion 0.1.14
assumptions: Low/base/high are explicit scenarios, not measured activity: 1 L1 worker for 1h, 1 L2 worker for 2h, 12 L3 workers for 4h; 1/10/16 participating cities. Categories are mutually exclusive workforce allocations.
At most one completed trip per production minute and no offline catch-up. Actual navigation may reduce throughput. 48 visible NPC network budget further limits simultaneous cities.

Before: closed virtual WOOD/STONE/FOOD. After: actual material items; exact blueprint requirements are reserved once, physical/virtual moves are transfers, breaking completed blocks recovers previously paid items.
Bread uses the vanilla three-wheat conversion: one bread per level per trip instead of three raw crop items; raw crops remain three per level, logs four, stone three. No currency paid by ArcCivs.

Shop SELL remains active now; planned SELL removal is a distinct target scenario, not an assumption that sales have stopped. Tracked config prices are illustrative disk evidence, not a verified current runtime quote.

Observed live 168h: shop mint 5752268.59 vault, jobs396907.80, farms16135, contracts35352.64. Admin 67001499 is excluded from normal income. Tokens remain separate. Requested item attribution only had cobble90 for4.49vault; missing materials mean no observation, not zero SELL price.

Owner-confirmed city deletion is available; durable SQL/local tombstones fence the deleted ID and owner history prevents repeat founding grants, including on another backend. One founder account belongs to at most one network city. New-city grant96logs96cobble24bread once; legacy conversion exactly remaining closed stock, not fresh grant. Max500cities, 12workers/city; physical output requires free registered loaded containers; virtual warehouse cap1728/3456/5184 items per building L1/L2/L3, separate physical27slot control barrel. Virtual production credits only its own building warehouse and stops when full.

Worst 24h12L3 workers: logs138240, rawcrops/stone103680, bread34560 items/city/day, assuming uninterrupted trips and withdrawals. At illustrative bread SELL8:276480vault/day; 16 cities alone would exceed typical current income, requiring explicit future postactivation observation. No offline mint or unload simulation.

Bootstrap/progression is now paid in actual build palettes rather than cheap three-resource quotes. Nordic builder1 requires ~1000 actual placeable materials, hall1~2200 before reuse of terrain. Full costs vary by style and existing blocks and are shown from immutable plan. Thus no universal coins-to-level price is invented.

Decision: enable user-requested item storage/production with existing raw unit rate, recipe-adjusted bread, exact construction sink and journal idempotency. Do not activate without existing owner decision; source/delivery separate from measured behavior.

0.1.14 deletion delta: first-ever founding remains 96 OAK_LOG, 96 COBBLESTONE and 24 BREAD; every refounding after a durable deletion grants 0/0/0. Deletion requires all virtual and legacy stock empty, preserves native containers/buildings and does not refund reserved construction costs. Production rates, capacities, prices, Vault and token payouts unchanged from 0.1.13. This prevents an unbounded deletion/refounding export loop; history must be backed up with canonical city state.

Control-barrel repeat loop is closed: each new SITE requires a player-placed BARREL before and after capture; missing SITE/CONSTRUCTING controls never spawn a replacement automatically. Existing ACTIVE legacy controls retain compatibility repair. Deletion leaves that same paid native barrel; refounding requires reusing it or placing another owned one, giving zero net new barrels per cycle. Before0.1.13 created the first control freely; after0.1.14 each new site transfers an existing item, without issuing a free control item.
